Here is your Application for Certificate of Visa Eligibility, filled in for you (P1). Write everything in block letters. Some blanks need information I don't have; those say NEEDS-YOU, with a note on what's missing.

Things to fix by hand once the real values are back in:
- B05 and B30: the form wants yyyy/mm/dd. Your dates of birth are stored as printed in the passports, which is probably a different order, so rewrite each one as year/month/day (for example, a date printed 05/03/1985 becomes 1985/03/05).
- B15: no format is given here, but use yyyy/mm/dd as well so all the dates on the form match.
- B02: check that GIVEN_P1 MIDDLE_P1 matches the "Given Name(s)" line in your passport exactly. If your passport shows only your first name there, delete MIDDLE_P1.
- B14: the form asks for the place of issue. If AUTHORITY_P1 comes back as an office name rather than a place, write the place shown in your passport's "Place of Issue" box.
- B20, B25 and B33: you're applying from the UK, so write the phone numbers in international format with the country code (+44 for a UK number).

What the NEEDS-YOU blanks need from you:
- B07: your country of birth. I only have your place of birth, not the country.
- B08: a national ID number, if you have one. If not, leave it blank.
- B09: whether you have ever entered or left Korea under a different name. Tick No or Yes, and give the name if Yes.
- B10: whether you hold any other citizenship. Tick No or Yes, and give details if Yes.
- B11: your passport type. If it's an ordinary passport (not diplomatic or official), tick Regular.
- B17: whether you hold any other valid passport. Tick No, or Yes and fill in a) to d).
- B18: your address in India, if you have one. ADDRESS_P1 is your UK address, so I put it under current residence in B19.
- B21: a landline number, or leave it blank if you don't have one.
- B22: your e-mail address.
- B36 and B37: the name and location of the school where you did your master's in computer science.
- B39 to B42: your employer's name, your position, and the company's address and phone number. Check with your HR team whether they want your current office or the Seoul office here.

Fill the NEEDS-YOU details straight into the form. Don't type passport or ID numbers into this chat.

One more thing: this form covers only you. Your wife and daughter will need their own applications when they join you. Your daughter's passport runs out on 1 January 2027, so she will probably need to renew it before she applies.
